hook.line: This guy figured out the secret to showing up in ChatGPT answers.
hook.visual: Her face cut out over a scrolling AEO playbook doc, a yellow 'FREE Lead Generation!' tag over a blue 'How to show up in ChatGPT AI answers' title.

beats.what: Two-tier title (yellow tag, blue headline) over the face; she names the payoff: appearing in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI answers.
Proof in numbers: 10 days from not appearing to appearing; captions switch to yellow sentence boxes at the top.
Promise of a step-by-step walk-through and the blog link at the end.
Early ask: save the video and follow, before step one.
Step 1: brainstorm 10 customer questions; face shrinks to a corner over the doc.
Step 2: add FAQ or how-to schema; face moves to a different corner.
Step 3: update and submit the sitemap to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster.
Step 4: format the page with headers and bullets so each Q&A stands alone.
Payoff: the blog URL shown as a black-on-white text box on screen.

why_it_works: Borrowed result first: a named person's 10-day before/after makes the steps feel proven before they are explained.
The full playbook doc stays visible behind her the whole time, so viewers pause and screenshot, which fits the 4k shares.
Face size and corner change at each step cut (green-screen re-crop), resetting attention without new footage.
The link is promised at 20 s and only shown at 58 s, so viewers stay to the end.
weaknesses: Background doc text is unreadably small at phone size; it signals depth but cannot be read without pausing.
Captions sit at the top over the title area and nearly all text is outside the safe zone (0.991 share).
Quiet mix (-30.2 LUFS) with no music bed.
for_robert: Promise the payoff early and reveal it in the last 3 s: Fred could hold the link or result card and only hand it over at the end.
